blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Criss Cross completed a nine-game elimination round sweep after overcoming Far Eastern University-DN Steel’s tough challenge, 25-22, 25-18, 23-25, 19-25, 15-10, in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Thursday at Mall of Asia Arena. The King Crunchers lost steam after taking a two-set lead, but five-time MVP Jude Garcia restored order in the decider to finish with 26 points, 15 excellent receptions, and five digs as he avoided the upset bid of his alma mater after a two-hour and 11-minute duel. “We have a good level of trust in one another.
